description: Style of one segment's subtitle, overriding the matching fields of the subtitle profile. Every field is optional: a field that is left out follows the subtitle profile, and a segment sent without `style` loses the style it had. `delta` and `deltaX` (and `subtitlePosition`) place the subtitle the way the subtitle profile does; when any of them is set, the segment's `cue_settings` position is ignored for that segment. Studio's editor preview and burn-in follow the style; SRT and WebVTT exports carry no style. Vertical subtitle profiles ignore it.

fontFamily.description: Font name, or `custom:<id>` for an uploaded custom font. Must not contain commas, braces, backslashes or line breaks.

fontSize.description: Font size, relative to a 720px-high video like the subtitle profile's

subtitlePosition.description: Where the subtitle is anchored horizontally (`left`, `center`, `right`), as in the subtitle profile

textColor.description: `#RRGGBB`, or `rgb()` / `rgba()` for a color with transparency, e.g. `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7)` for a 70% opaque black. Eight-digit hex is not accepted.

backgroundType.description: How the text is separated from the video.

backgroundColor.description: `#RRGGBB`, or `rgb()` / `rgba()` for a color with transparency, e.g. `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7)` for a 70% opaque black. Eight-digit hex is not accepted.

delta.description: Distance from the bottom, in percent of the video height. Higher moves the subtitle up.

deltaX.description: Shift from the center, in percent of the video width. Negative moves it left.
